entries.db3652775c8df22e: In September 2025, the company formulated the medium-term management plan 'DCX2030', with the fiscal year ending July 2030 as its final year. Viewing 2027, the year of its 50th anniversary, as a milestone, the plan promotes transformation as a second founding period. The plan centers on improving the productivity and quality of software development through the use of AI and other technologies, growth investment in the company's own cloud services and smart agriculture, expanding solution proposals through collaboration with partner companies, and active investment in human capital. The company plans to develop and expand focus areas such as cloud services and smart agriculture into revenue pillars on a par with contract development.
